gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (INFLUENCE) thinkers of the decade.
gaps.explanation: 'Influential' describes a person who influences others.

gaps.sentence: The medicine may cause ___ (SLEEP), so avoid driving.
gaps.hint: noun: the state of wanting to sleep
gaps.explanation: 'Cause sleepiness' — the noun for the drowsy state.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (APPOINT) at the election result.
The company is famous for its ___ (INNOVATE) designs.

gaps.explanation: The journey causes tiredness: tiring. 'Tiresome' means annoying.

gaps.sentence: The factory has doubled its ___ (PRODUCE) of electric batteries.
gaps.explanation: 'Its production' — the noun for the amount manufactured follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: The economy shows signs of ___ (RECOVER) after the recession.
